At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin or San Francisco (Hybrid)

For 30 years, the web has run on a simple economic bargain: trading content for human attention. That attention has been monetized through advertising, subscriptions, and e-commerce. This bargain funded the Internet as we know it.
But as agents become the dominant Internet users, the model is breaking. An agent does not look at ads or need to maintain a monthly subscription to all the tools it wants to access. It reads a page or consumes a data feed once, takes what it needs, and moves on. Across the web, AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back . We need new business models, fit for this new era.
Cloudflare has spent years detecting bots, allowing domain owners to take control of whether bots can access them. What's been missing is the other half: how agents interact with those sites once they're let in. That's what our team, the Agentic Internet team is focused on: making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable .

These four primitives are all built on open standards, so no single company owns the rails. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen!
You can read more about some of our big bets here and here .

Shape the product strategy for new Internet-scale business models
Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches
Partner with Engineering, Design, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity
Work with Partnerships and BD to define the new business models for the open web
Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more

5+ years as a technical PM; developer-facing experience and AI/ML preferred
A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer ‘show’ over ‘tell’
A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity
Technically literate — you don't need to write Rust, but you should be able to push back on a tech lead on the merits of a particular direction
Payments, FinTech, or blockchain experience is a plus
Team oriented - You’d rather get it right than be right
How we work
At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our Careers page .
Why this role
You’re joining a fast-moving team, breaking new ground. Read more about some of our big bets here and here .

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the full consumer journey—from inspiration and discovery through consideration, planning, and action. Creators bring ideas to life, Pinners signal emerging interests and intent, and advertisers help people act on what inspires them.

This role will define how Pinterest measures that flywheel, helping advertisers understand how Pinterest and its creators build awareness and drive business outcomes, while helping creators understand the value they generate and unlock new opportunities with brands.
The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial ads measurement experience and a deep understanding of how advertisers set objectives, deploy tactics across the full funnel, and evaluate outcomes. They have worked cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other partners and can translate complex measurement methods into credible, useful, and scalable products.

Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for demonstrating the full-funnel value of Pinterest, including the creator–Pinner–advertiser flywheel. Define the vision for new and existing measurement capabilities and translate advertiser and creator needs into clear product and technical requirements.

Create and deliver a multi-quarter roadmap, aligning data foundations, measurement methodologies, experimentation, privacy guardrails, and customer-facing experiences to drive measurable creator, advertiser, and Pinner outcomes.
Partner day-to-day with engineering, data science/analytics, design, and research to deliver high-quality products; collaborate with PMM, sales, partnerships, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity for launches. Work closely with PM peers across Ads, Creators, Content, and Shopping to manage dependencies, align measurement frameworks and experiment design, coordinate GTM, and incorporate customer feedback.
Build new and iterate on measurement products that help advertisers understand how creator content, organic engagement, and paid media contribute across awareness, consideration, intent, conversion, and longer-term value. Enable creators to understand the value they generate for brands and identify new business opportunities. Define success metrics and validation standards up front, track adoption and quality post-launch, and use insights to update the roadmap.

8+ years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 3–5+ years of substantial ads or marketing measurement experience.
Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.
Deep understanding of the full marketing funnel and how advertisers set objectives, deploy tactics, and evaluate outcomes.
Experience working with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders.
Strong quantitative judgment and understanding of attribution, incrementality, experimentation, brand lift, conversion lift, and measurement tradeoffs.
Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the context of online platforms or multi-sided ecosystems.
Preferred but not required: Experience with creator, influencer, branded-content, social, video, commerce, or organic-and-paid measurement.
Preferred but not required: Experience building advertiser-facing measurement products or working with advertisers, agencies, creators, marketing science teams, or measurement partners.
Preferred but not required: Technical degree in CS/Statistics/Math/Engineering/Economics.
Preferred but not required: Experience designing, running, or analyzing incrementality or lift experiments.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.
But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.
The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch.

This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.
The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.
This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
Identify and support new creator and developer categories
Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
About the Public Sector team
Sierra recently received FedRAMP High certification, enabling us to bring our industry-leading technology to partners in the US public sector. We’re now building our founding public sector team to redefine the relationship between the government and its citizenry.
Today, our agents already enable citizens to access social services, report fraud, and understand complex government systems. Simultaneously, they empower government officials to better hear the concerns and inquiries of their constituencies.
We are explicitly nonpartisan and committed to empowering public servants to leverage AI to advance their important missions.
In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Build enterprise-grade AI agents for government institutions: As an Agent Product Manager at Sierra, you will partner directly with our engineers and public sector customers to build and ship AI agents that serve people across high-stakes, mission-critical interactions. These agents will help constituents navigate complex programs, complete important tasks, and get timely, trustworthy support while meeting the security, accessibility, and reliability standards government work demands.
Discover where agents can make the greatest impact: Ground-up discovery is a critical part of the role. Work closely with federal and state institutions to understand their missions, operating constraints, constituent needs, and service-delivery workflows. Identify and prioritize new opportunities for AI agents to improve access, responsiveness, and outcomes.
Engage with customers at every level: Become a trusted advisor to public sector leaders and a hands-on partner to their working teams. Discover and assess requirements, prepare and present demonstrations, navigate technical and operational challenges with customer counterparts, and continuously improve agents to fit each institution’s policies and workflows.
Own outcomes from concept through production: Translate mission goals into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and measurable definition of success. Coordinate across customer stakeholders, engineering, design, research, security, and operations to take agents from initial concept through launch and ongoing iteration.
Shape the platform and public sector roadmap: Your direct work with government institutions will guide the evolution of Sierra’s core platform. Surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform teams to shape the future of AI agent development for the public sector.
Help build Sierra’s public sector business: Partner closely with public sector leadership on market strategy, product investments, and repeatable approaches that allow the team to scale quickly while preserving the trust and craftsmanship our customers expect.
Example projects
These are examples of projects our healthcare team has worked on:
Build agents that help people understand eligibility, apply for benefits, check case status, and navigate complex social-service programs.
Develop secure reporting experiences that make it easier to report fraud, waste, abuse, or other concerns and route each submission appropriately.
Create voice and chat agents that answer questions about licenses, permits, taxes, public records, and other high-volume government services across languages and channels.
Design proactive and long-horizon agents that keep constituents informed, collect missing information, and guide them through multi-step government processes over time.
Turn patterns in constituent conversations into actionable insights that help public officials understand emerging needs and improve service delivery.

5-7+ years of experience developing highly technical products.
Experience in Product Management or a similar product development role at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.
A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of our institutions to transform outcomes for the people they serve.
Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs, navigate complex organizations, and solve real-world problems. A core part of the role is coordinating directly with public servants and technical stakeholders to understand their workflows.
Experience crafting and tailoring messages for different audiences, including senior executives and public sector leaders.
Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent developments in AI.
Strong product judgment and a track record of driving ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through launch and measurable impact.
A degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Even better...
Experience building or deploying AI/LLM products, especially conversational or long-horizon agents, and familiarity with evaluation, retrieval, prompt engineering, or agent tooling.
Experience with government technology or working with public sector institutions, including an understanding of procurement, regulation, security, accessibility, and patterns of partnership.
A demonstrated track record of operating in ambiguity, for example as part of a founding team, a new initiative within a large organization, or a forward-deployed product or engineering team.
Some coding experience with React, TypeScript, and Go, or experience prototyping technical products directly with engineers.
An MBA or equivalent professional experience at the intersection of technology, operations, and strategy.
Past roles that involved working directly with end customers to influence software development.

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own
Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.
Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.
Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.
Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.
Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.
Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.
Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.
Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.
Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.
Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.
Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Engineering or highly technical product background.
Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Outcome
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

ABOUT THE ROLE This is your opportunity to own a real product at a company building something genuinely new. As our Senior Product Manager, you join a small, senior product team at a stage where one person's judgment visibly shapes the product.
You will own product topics end to end: understanding the customer, deciding what is worth building and why, shaping the concept, and seeing it through to a shipped result that delivers value. You do this for your own set of topics, alongside our Director Product Management and our CPO, who both work hands-on.

You start by owning the flow of customer requests and insights, the fastest way to learn our product and our customers, and grow over the first 6 to 12 months into owning whole product areas with the same autonomy. You develop the product; our
engineers build it.
We are building a product in a new category, so there is no playbook to copy. The work is genuinely conceptual: understand how digital B2B products work, understand our users' problems, and invent viable solutions. Our engineering team works closely and continuously with product, no throwing specs over a wall, and most of that collaboration happens remotely.
If you want real ownership, the influence to shape a product from an early stage, and the discipline of a spec-driven, high-bar team, this is the right moment to join.
What will be your responsibility Own a set of product topics end to end, from the customer problem through to a shipped result that delivers real value
Decide what is worth building and in what order for your topics, shape the concept, and drive it through delivery together with engineering
Run discovery with customers to understand what they actually need, test your assumptions rather than building on guesses, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
Own the flow of customer requests and insights: make sense of what customers are asking for, decide what it means for the product, route it to the right place, and turn a stream of raw input into clear product direction
Translate real problems into clear, well-scoped, buildable definitions, working spec-driven (currently with OpenSpec) at a high bar
Invent viable product concepts in a category with no existing product to copy
Shape the UX and UI together with engineering, based on the existing product and the component library - we have no dedicated designer in the team
Work hand in hand with our remote engineering team throughout the build rather than through handover: analyse a solution for gaps and edge cases before it is built, using AI where it helps, and after shipping, check whether the outcome delivered its intended value and works for users
What you'll need A track record of owning B2B SaaS products end to end, from customer problem to shipped outcome, with real accountability for whether they delivered value
A genuine understanding of how digital B2B products work, and the ability to invent viable concepts rather than copy existing patterns
Strong requirements and scoping judgment: you make vague problems complete, unambiguous and correctly scoped, and you know what to leave out
A structured, process-driven way of working, paired with genuine comfort in a fast, unstructured startup environment
Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you think, write specs and
analyse problems, since we're an AI-first team and expect the same of you.
Experience working in a spec-driven environment (OpenSpec or similar); turning fuzzy intent into rigorous, complete, buildable definition is second nature to you
Data-model fluency: you reason comfortably about entities and how they relate, enough to break problems down and hold a real bar with engineering
Technical fluency: not afraid of a terminal, and able to reason about data flows, system constraints, and how an agentic product behaves
Proven experience collaborating closely with a remote engineering team
Fluent in English; professional German is a strong plus given our customers
What we'll offer you Remote-first setup, Europe-based so we stay reasonably timezone-aligned, with access to our Munich office and backyard workspace
Flexible working hours and a "take what you need" vacation policy
Direct collaboration with our Director Product Management and CPO, and real ownership of your own product areas

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

This position sits on the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.
Verkada sells through partners. Two products carry that motion: the Verkada Store (vStore) , where partners quote, price, and order, and the Partner Portal , where partners run their Verkada business — registering deals, tracking orders and renewals, pulling pricebooks and inventory, requesting marketing funds, and reaching the training and enablement they need to sell. You own both. One partner experience, two surfaces.
Verkada's ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with, and the Store and the Portal are where that promise is either kept or broken. The bar is a system partners choose to use: intuitive enough to need almost no training, useful enough that nobody keeps a side spreadsheet, and scalable enough that order volume can grow faster than the supporting headcount growth.
This is a build role. vStore is homegrown and in active development, and partner self-service ordering is one of the company's primary levers to scale revenue without scaling headcount. You will own the roadmap end to end with a dedicated engineering team. Executives, Sales, Marketing, and Finance are all invested in these products, so success depends as much on building alignment as on shipping.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Take full ownership of strategy, prioritization, PRDs, and user experience for both core partner platforms, from quote-to-order pathways to navigation and identity management.
Hold both products to a product standard, not an internal-tool standard. The honest measure is whether a partner would rather use the Store than call someone, and whether an internal user would rather use it than build a workaround.
Partner with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Deal Desk to translate needs into features and workflow changes across the full partner journey.
Talk to partners directly. Partner AEs, SEs, order admins, and finance admins each use these products differently, and the roadmap should reflect what they do, not what internal stakeholders assume they do.
Lead cross-functional requirements sessions to define functional scope. Surface the unspoken and conflicting requirements, and drive to a decision.
Directly impact key operational metrics—including board-level targets for self-service order adoption, reduced quote cycle times, straight-through order processing, and support ticket deflection across key partner personas.
Recommend changes to development and system standards that improve scalability and reduce maintenance burden.

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform.

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.
What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.
What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
Toast is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Enterprise Data Solutions (EDS) organization. EDS is Toast’s central data organization — building the trusted, scalable foundation that enables every domain to operate with data confidently.
You will own the data platform and the self-service experience that domain technical data teams operate within. Your stakeholder is the engineer, the analyst, the domain data team building and maintaining data products across Toast’s ecosystem.

You own the platform roadmap — what capabilities exist, what gets built next, and how the self-service experience evolves as domains mature.

You design paved paths that make the right way the easy way, drive adoption of platform capabilities, and partner deeply with Data Engineering & Platform as Data Governance to define what the ecosystem needs to become.

As domains grow more independent, your work becomes more critical — the platform is what makes decentralized operation sustainable at scale.

Own the platform product roadmap — catalog, semantic layer, observability, access management, lineage, and self-service tooling — prioritizing by what unlocks domain independence.
Design and evolve the self-service experience: discovery, onboarding, certification workflows, and documentation.
Run discovery with domain technical data teams — understand their needs, pain points, and maturity — and translate into platform requirements.
Design the paved paths, templates, and tooling domain teams follow to build and maintain data products — ensuring governance standards are enforceable through platform capabilities.
Drive platform adoption. Measure whether teams are using what you shipped and iterate until they are.
Partner hand-in-hand with Data Engineering & Platform — they build and operate the platform; you define what it needs to become and why — balancing new capability against reliability and operational excellence.
Ensure domain maturity progression is unblocked by tooling — teams ready to advance have what they need.
Maintain interoperability — data products built by any domain are discoverable, governed, and consumable by others (humans and AI agents).

7+ years in product management, with significant experience in data platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products
Experience designing for technical teams as the customer — building tools, frameworks, and paved paths that engineers and analysts adopt willingly
Track record shipping platform capabilities that enable self-service at scale
Experience operating in strategic ambiguity — this function is being built, not inherited
Deep understanding of the modern data stack: warehouses, orchestration, semantic layers, catalogs, data quality frameworks, observability
Familiarity with data mesh or federated data architecture — strong systems thinker who designs operating models and platform experiences, not just features

Significant experience working on growth or growth-adjacent product surfaces, ideally owning DAU/WAU or retention metrics

Strong product instincts and analytical judgment, with the ability to use experiments and data to make meaningful decisions

Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.
Why This Role
Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.
We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.
You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.
The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.
There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.

As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.

From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.
Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.
Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.
You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.

You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.

If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals.

You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes.

You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers.

This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.
AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation

Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation

MongoDB is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Revenue and Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities that enable accurate, scalable, and efficient revenue operations.
This role will work closely with the Group Product Manager, Quote to Cash (QTC), owning the OTC and revenue processes within the broader QTC organization, while partnering across Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and Program Management to improve the end-to-end order-to-cash lifecycle — order management through billing, collections, revenue recognition, and close — and help the business scale with reliable, increasingly automated revenue systems.
You will own product discovery, prioritization, requirements, delivery partnership, and launch readiness across the OTC and revenue lifecycle — including order management, subscription and contract operations, billing, accounts receivable, collections, renewals, revenue recognition, month-end and quarter-end close, and ERP integrations.

The central focus of this role is revenue accuracy and timeliness: reducing manual adjustments, strengthening SOX and audit controls, accelerating time to invoice and cash, and building a foundation for continuous process improvement across the revenue lifecycle.

Define and maintain the Revenue/OTC product vision, strategy, roadmap, and release priorities in alignment with company objectives, with revenue accuracy and close efficiency as the north star
Partner closely with the Group Product Manager, QTC to align the OTC and revenue roadmap with the broader Quote to Cash strategy, while owning the order-to-cash and revenue processes as your dedicated area of focus
Build deep expertise in NetSuite and the surrounding revenue systems landscape, including billing, accounts receivable, revenue recognition, month-end and quarter-end close, order management, contract and subscription data, ERP integrations, and related Finance and GTM systems
Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements across the OTC lifecycle; translate them into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and an actionable product backlog
Lead prioritization across competing Finance, Revenue Operations, and Sales needs, balancing near-term business value with long-term scalability and architectural health of revenue systems
Partner with Stakeholders, Lead PdM, Engineering, Architecture, TPM/Program Management, and implementation partners to evaluate and integrate strategic first- and third-party solutions for OTC and revenue processes
Define success metrics and KPIs for Revenue/OTC initiatives — such as billing accuracy, days sales outstanding (DSO), manual journal entry volume, and close cycle time — using data and stakeholder feedback to validate assumptions and measure post-launch outcomes
Own and improve end-to-end revenue workflows across order capture, billing, accounts receivable, collections, renewals, revenue recognition, month-end/quarter-end close, and reporting, including support for subscription and consumption-based business models
Provide product oversight for revenue controls, data definitions, business logic, integrations, and the overall consistency of the user experience across OTC systems
Coordinate integrated, cross-functional testing and partner with technology and business leads on release strategy, change management, training, and adoption for revenue system changes
Identify opportunities to improve revenue accuracy, accelerate time to invoice and cash, reduce billing leakage and manual journal entries, strengthen auditability and SOX compliance, simplify close processes, and maximize the return on investment of Revenue/OTC products
Communicate product decisions, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to stakeholders and executive audiences, with particular fluency in revenue and close-related metrics

Required Experience and Skills
8+ years of relevant product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise business systems and influencing stakeholders at all levels
Strong experience with Order to Cash (OTC), Quote to Cash, or adjacent revenue and finance processes, with a clear emphasis on the order-to-cash and revenue recognition side of the lifecycle
Hands-on understanding of NetSuite-based billing and revenue operations, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, collections, month-end and quarter-end close, order management, subscription and contract data, and ERP or downstream revenue integrations
Strong NetSuite product and integration experience, with a solid understanding of Finance operations, revenue accounting, billing controls, SOX/audit requirements, and the upstream GTM processes that drive downstream revenue outcomes
Experience working with Agile/Scrum delivery teams as a Product Owner or equivalent product leader
Strong data analysis and metrics skills, including the ability to define revenue and close-related KPIs (e.g., DSO, billing accuracy, close cycle time) and use quantitative and qualitative inputs to drive prioritization
Experience managing complex integrations, data models, business rules, and dependencies across enterprise revenue platforms
Demonstrated success collaborating across Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Engineering, Architecture, and other cross-functional teams
Experience with consumption-based, subscription, or other complex commercial business models is a plus
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree is a plus
Personal Attributes
Strategic thinker who can connect revenue systems decisions to business and financial outcomes
Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and dependencies across the OTC lifecycle
Strong communicator who can make complex technical, financial, and operational topics clear to varied audiences
Effective decision-maker and problem solver who brings structure to ambiguity, especially around revenue controls and close processes
Self-motivated, adaptable, collaborative, and able to influence without direct authority
Customer- and stakeholder-focused, with a strong bias toward measurable revenue outcomes and continuous improvement
Why This Role Matters
Order to Cash is a critical business capability connecting commercial execution to accurate billing, cash collection, revenue recognition, and financial reporting. In this role, you will help make the revenue lifecycle a scalable business enabler by improving revenue integrity, strengthening NetSuite and related system foundations, accelerating cash realization, tightening SOX and audit controls, and reducing operational effort and risk across the OTC and close process.

* mit einer abgeschlossenen höheren Ausbildung in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Banking & Finance oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung und fundiertem bankfachlichem Know-how

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.
Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.
As a Senior Product Manager, you own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a key product area within Rithum's commerce platform. You operate largely independently, tackle open-ended and ambiguous problems, and bring cross-functional teams together around a shared vision. You are expected to have deep expertise in your domain and leverage AI-powered capabilities to rapidly shape the next generation of commerce for the world's largest retailers and brands.

Be the owner of your product and drive the long-term vision for the world’s leading eCommerce platform, leveraging AI-first approaches to accelerate discovery, decision-making, and delivery.
Synthesize qualitative inputs—including client interviews, support tickets, and survey feedback—using AI tools to identify themes, opportunity areas, and prioritization inputs that inform product strategy.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to drive efficient business processes, improve team operations, and align client needs with internal objectives.
Own and drive roadmap prioritization for your product area, making independent decisions on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs while incorporating AI-assisted insights and data exploration.
Leverage AI tools to prototype and validate product concepts and workflows (e.g., user flows, wireframe descriptions, low-fidelity mocks) to de-risk ideas prior to engineering investment.
Lead end-to-end product development & execution from concept to launch (e.g., PRDs, prioritization, client discussions, testing & QA, change management, client adoption/engagement, etc.), holding yourself and your cross-functional team accountable for high-quality, timely delivery.
Use AI to accelerate product documentation workflows (PRDs, one-pagers, release notes) while exercising strong editorial judgment and maintaining product quality and clarity.
Track development progress, report on status to stakeholders, and assist in managing product release cycles. Support product testing and validation to ensure high-quality releases and a seamless user experience.
Be the voice and champion of our clients; triage incoming requests with urgency and follow-through and build relationships grounded in trust.
Lead and influence stakeholders across functional teams of designers and engineers to ensure successful delivery at a fast velocity; ensuring high product validation and QA standards are met.

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more.

We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.
You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.
Outcomes
Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.
Customer adoption of shipped work: Usage and adoption rates of new and materially updated capabilities within our target ICP.
Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.
Customer and business impact: Expansion revenue, win rate, retention, and customer value creation attributable to your product work.
Cross-functional coherence: Engineering, Research, and GTM operating from one shared reality about what matters most, and why.
Strategic contribution: Bets you've brought to the table, backed by customer conviction and market insight, that shaped the roadmap beyond your own surface.

Own a Meaningful Product Surface End-to-End
Drive the full lifecycle of your product surface, from discovery to delivery to adoption. Write crisp specs, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner with engineering. Own outcomes, not outputs. At this level, we expect you to define the surface you’re working on in addition to executing against it.
Build Direct Customer Intuition
Spend meaningful, consistent time with customers. Work alongside our PhD-level Researchers, but bring your own developed point of view on how users and buyers at Fortune 1000 brands think, what they need, and where the market is moving.
Make AI-Native Product Decisions
Own the AI layer of your surface: eval strategies, quality loops, failure-mode design, when to trust the model versus defer to humans. This is what separates us from AI-washed research tools, and you'll help us defend and extend that gap.
Operate as a Force Multiplier Across R&D and GTM
Drive clarity on tradeoffs, eliminate mid-stream thrash, and ensure Engineering, Research, and GTM are working from one shared reality about what matters and why. At this level, we expect you to create alignment.
Contribute to Company-Level Decisions & Roadmap
Your impact should reach well beyond what you ship. Bring bets to the betting table backed by real customer conviction, competitive insight, and business judgment. Weigh in on how we plan quarters, how we position against competitors, and how we tell our story to customers. See your bets through with evidence, judgment, and taste.

7+ years as a Product Manager , including meaningful time at a company known for strong product culture — where you learned what a great product org looks like from great leaders, and where you were trusted to operate with real autonomy.

AI-native fluency. You've shipped LLM-based features in production. You use AI tools fluently in your own PM work to draft, prototype, research, and design. You have a real, developed point of view on how the PM role is changing in an AI-native world.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. Clarity under compression is a baseline expectation. At this level, you're also helping set the standard for how the team communicates.
Strong technical fluency. Comfortable driving real conversations with senior engineers about architecture, tradeoffs, and constraints — not just translating between them.
Strategic range. You've operated beyond your own surface and influenced roadmap direction, contributed to company-level planning, and shaped how your org thinks about a market. You have opinions that change what gets built, and you back them with evidence.

Du denkst Produkte nicht in Features, sondern vom echten Bedarf der Nutzer aus? Du willst Strategie, Kundenfeedback und technische Möglichkeiten zusammenbringen – und MOCO vom ersten Tag an mitgestalten?
Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!
Was dich erwartet
Als Product-Manager denkst du vom Kunden aus – und von übermorgen her. Du kennst die Welt von Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleistern: wie sie planen, abrechnen, kommunizieren, wachsen. Dieses Verständnis nutzt du, um nicht nur das nächste Feature zu durchdenken, sondern die Richtung des Produkts mitzubestimmen.

Du arbeitest im engen Austausch mit Entwicklung und Customer Operations, bringst Kundenfeedback, die technische und strategische Perspektive zusammen – und hilfst dem Team, die richtigen Entscheidungen zur richtigen Zeit zu treffen.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben
Konzeption: Du fragst zuerst nach dem Warum. Die eigentliche Anforderung hinter einem Feature Request ist dein Ausgangspunk. Von dort denkst du Lösungsansätze ganzheitlich durch und bereitest sie präzise für die Entwicklung auf.
Produkt-Design: Figma ist dir vertraut, und du hast ein Auge für Design – du erkennst, was ein Interface intuitiv, klar und angenehm nutzbar macht.
Nah am User: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit Kunden, challengest Annahmen und weißt, was wirklich gebraucht und nicht nur laut gewünscht wird.
Testing & QA: Du begleitest die Umsetzung aktiv, gibst Feedback im Prozess und stellst sicher, dass das fertige Feature die ursprüngliche Anforderung trifft.
Blick auf das große Ganze: Du denkst MOCO nicht feature-weise, sondern in Richtungen. Du erkennst Muster in Kundenfeedback, Marktentwicklung und technischen Möglichkeiten – und hilfst dem Team, daraus klare Prioritäten zu machen.
Blog & Handbuch: Du erklärst, was neu ist und warum es wichtig ist. Kurz, prägnant, und ohne Buzzwords Gutes Schreiben ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern Teil der Arbeit.
Qualifikation
Dein Profil
Erfahrung im Produktmanagement : Du hast Produkte im B2B SaaS-Kontext mitgestaltet – von der Konzeption bis zum Release. Du weißt, wie gute Entscheidungen entstehen und wann sie getroffen werden müssen.
Verständnis für Agentur- & Dienstleistungsprozesse: Du weißt, wie Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleister arbeiten. Idealerweise aus eigener Erfahrung oder aus einem früheren Produkt in diesem Segment.
Trendbewusstsein: Du verfolgst, was sich in der Branche technologisch, gestalterisch und konzeptionell verändert. KI interessiert dich nicht als Hype, sondern als echte Möglichkeit.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du schreibst gut. Nicht nur klar und fehlerfrei, sondern so, dass Menschen verstehen, warum etwas wichtig ist.
Bonus-Skill: Du kennst MOCO und hast vielleicht sogar schon damit gearbeitet.

Was wir bieten
Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum – Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter**.**
Wachstum, das sich anfühlt – Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache – Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen – Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen. Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg frisches Obst, Kaffee, gekühlte Getränke und ein gemeinsames wöchentliches Frühstück.
Möglichkeit: auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug**)**
Klingt interessant?
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! – deine Gehaltsvorstellung und dein frühestmöglicher Starttermin.

We Breathe Life Into Data
At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission.

That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience.

The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners.

Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.
As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.
The Opportunity at Komodo Health
Komodo Health's AI Platform and Services organization builds the platform every AI product at Komodo runs on: agent infrastructure, evals, data context, and the surfaces customers touch. Small pods build on shared primitives and ship in weeks. Product managers here build the first versions of what they propose and to iterate alongside their teams quickly.
The suite that built this business was designed for an analyst at a screen. The platform underneath it now reasons. Our flagship product Navigator runs investigations that used to take a person weeks, and an ai-augmented product suite interoperates with it to streamline workflows. We are just getting started. What the next generation of the suite actually is remains an open question, and today it needs ownership.
That question is this seat. You will define the next generation of Komodo's product suite and prove it by building it. The current surfaces are your material and your distribution. The mandate is what comes after them. Principal here means your answer sets the pattern for every surface that follows.
Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…
Put a thesis on record for what the next generation of the suite is, argued in working software customers have touched, and won cross-functional and leadership support for it.
Built the first version of at least two new products from that thesis yourself, then ran a pod of four or fewer from prototype to GA with no dedicated project management.
Those products live in customer environments, with measurable revenue, adoption, or retention impact.
Made the current suite smaller. At least one existing legacy solution retired or folded into its successor, without customer churn.
You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities:
Own the thesis for what customers touch. Study how they actually work, decide what should exist, and revise the argument as models improve.
Build first versions with AI tools and platform primitives. Bring engineering in to scale what shows value, and drop what does not.
Deploy forward. Work inside customer environments where necessary, scope in real time during contracting cycles, and treat deployment as part of the product.
Propose and defend the shape of the growing portfolio. As the new generation lands, you decide what the existing solutions become.
Set the pattern. Your architecture and your build habits become how the surface pods around you work.
